# Exit policy book (G01 v2, generated by `python -m india.exitbook verdict`)

For each entry set and situation (Nifty trend at the signal close), the exits that led in development (2000-2017, top 3 by 10-slot book growth over drawdown) and whether each held up in validation (2018-2023: top 5, positive net per trade, positive book growth). No exit beats its own-duration hold on average (E02), so excess over the time-matched null is shown, not required: the book chooses among exits by capital speed and drawdown. Cells under 300 trades per policy are INCONCLUSIVE. Read beside the registry verdicts, never instead of them.
